DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_Sekhmet:
Once a fierce creature feared as a symbol of death.
When <characterName id=|Anubis|/> claimed that mantle, wealthy elites looking for a replacement beguiled the species with wine.
Before long, <characterName id=|Sekhmet|/> became a symbol of high nobility.

Coughs <itemName id=|Wool| style=|Status_Keyword|/> balls and hunts fish while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_Sekhmet:
While at base, 
boosts <characterName id=|Anubis| style=|Status_Keyword|/>'s work speed by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. 
Increases efficiency by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</> if <characterName id=|Sekhmet|/> is also working at a Workbench, Workshop, or other related facilities. (Does not stack)

Coughs <itemName id=|Wool| style=|Status_Keyword|/> balls and hunts fish while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
